note: Forest Service campground on the Black River west of Williamsville, at the historic Markham Springs mill pond and the restored Fuchs House. Recreation.gov takes reservations for the electric Birch loop from May 1 to Labor Day; the three primitive loops are first come, first served, in woods along the river. Eagle Bluff Trail, a 1.5-mile loop, follows the river. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $10-17 (doubles $20/$34), Birch 50A, showers/vault/water, 14 nights. Season now May 1 - Oct 1 (FS 2026). FCFS after_cutoff -> some_sites (non-electric never reservable). WATERFRONT DOWN riverview -> not waterfront. Pin moves ~930 m to the loops. Phone 573-785-1475 to add.
flags: PIN (move ~930 m): stored 36.9733,-90.6017 is the recreation.gov facility point, south of Highway 49 and away from the campground. The catalog's site points put the loops at 36.9805-36.9830,-90.603..-90.607; move to the Birch electric loop, 36.9810,-90.6060.

WATERFRONT DOWN (riverview -> not waterfront): the river sites are River loop 12-20 (non-electric, 'in a wooded setting along the Black River'). Measured from the catalog points: 13 ~30 m and 14 ~40 m from the water, 15/16/12 ~45-75 m, the rest farther - all across a wooded bank with no open apron, so none is riverfront. The recreation.gov summer photos of sites 13 and 14 show only forest, no water, so riverview is not earned either. The Birch electric loop (the only loop listed for RVs) is ~150 m+ from the river.

RIG FIT: recreation.gov lists the 20 non-electric sites for Tent and Trailer only (no 'RV'), 30-ft back-ins; the FS says 'pop-up campers fit nicely at sites on these loops'. A 23-ft motorhome uses the 12 Birch sites (60-ft pull-throughs). Written in sites.note.

BOOKING: FS 'Reservation needed ... Campground - From May 1 to Labor Day'; recreation.gov sells only the 12 Birch sites (non-electric 'Not Reservable'). fcfs changed after_cutoff -> some_sites. Booking season May 1 - Labor Day not written (Labor Day moves). Cutoff: FS 'at least 5 days in advance', rec.gov rule reservationCutOff 4 - reserve_until not written.
AMPERAGE: 11 of the 12 bookable Birch sites list 50 A; site 24 lists none - written 50.
